metropolis_franco.name: Bar Brioschi
metropolis_franco.label: What'll it be?
metropolis_franco.greet: Panettone by the slice, and hot chocolate with coffee and cream, the proper way. Anything you fish out of the canal, I'll take it. My wall has room.

metropolis_chiara.name: Pozzi Sartoria
metropolis_chiara.label: Let's see your fabric
metropolis_chiara.greet: Offcuts by the bundle, and patterns for the cosy things. Bring me fabric or winter flowers and I'll pay. A collection doesn't sew itself.

metropolis_gennaro.name: Gennaro's chestnuts
metropolis_gennaro.label: A cone of chestnuts
metropolis_gennaro.greet: Hot chestnuts, roasted on the coals! Warm your hands first, then your heart. Raw chestnuts I'll buy, if you find any. Fog tomorrow, by the way. My knee says so.

metropolis_ottavio.name: The park keeper's hut
metropolis_ottavio.label: Anything from the park?
metropolis_ottavio.greet: Prunings by the bundle, young trees, and plans for beds and hedges. Flowers from the park beds I'll buy back, for the greenhouse.

metropolis_annoni.name: The Cathedral Works
metropolis_annoni.label: Marble, plans, centuries
metropolis_annoni.greet: Marble from the yard by the bundle, and statue and pillar plans from the archive. We've been selling both since 1387. No hurry.

metropolis_ambrogio.name: The tram depot
metropolis_ambrogio.label: Anything from the depot?
metropolis_ambrogio.greet: Old overhead wire by the coil, and a spare driver's cap, if you've got the head for it. Scrap metal I'll take for the depot. Carlotta approves.
